While a charge alert waits, Volt stays connected in the background with a notification, for up to 12 hours. The low battery alert needs Volt to be connected already.
Phones that close apps in the background, like Xiaomi, can stop the alert. In Volt\'s app settings, set battery use to No restrictions.

Volt pauses charging and sets the scooter to resume in about 2 minutes, to check the scooter\'s clock and schedule. It takes about 3–5 minutes; keep the phone near the scooter.

Volt didn\'t see this charge begin, so it would plan for a fresh charger, which usually finishes early. Watching the charger for about 10 minutes lets it plan closer to your time, still with the 20-minute buffer. Volt stays connected and shows a notification until the schedule is set.
